annotations.text:
MID-RUN
The graph strip carries the live state: search/assess/refine are done and show ×2 because the loop actually ran twice, resolve_refs is marked as the cross-reference step, write is pulsing, everything downstream is dashed = not taken yet.

Citations are deliberately absent — verify has not run, so there is nothing verified to show.

COMPLETED
Same strip, finalize lit. This is the state you inspect in: answer with numbered chips, citation cards with the excerpt and provenance, evidence split search vs cross-reference.

The dashed card at the bottom is the rejected state for reference — not part of this run.

REFERENCE
Every node, guard, terminal, ResearchState field and Budget value. Not part of the page — this is what the compact strip is an abbreviation of.

If this moves to docs/ it should become mermaid; the strip stays hand-drawn SVG because mermaid cannot do live per-node highlighting.

WHAT CHANGED
The linear execution list is gone. It showed order but hid topology.

Now: grouped graph (RESEARCH / EVIDENCE / GENERATE — the same subgraph device waku uses), node state by colour, ×N badges for loops, and the log demoted to a compact feed on the right.
